steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: Chess is played on an 8 by 8 board. Each side starts with 16 pieces: 8 pawns and 8 others. White moves first.

steps.title: The starting position
steps.body: White's pieces start on the bottom two ranks. Every board has a light square in the bottom right corner. For White that is h1.

steps.question: How many pieces does each player start with?

steps.body: Move the pawn on e2 forward two squares to e4.
steps.hint: Pawns can jump two squares on their first move.
steps.success: Good. That is the most popular first move in chess.
